title: DcatCatalogRecordBase
description:
Base interface for DCAT Catalog Record without JSON-LD context.
This is the context-free variant of IDcatCatalogRecord, intended for embedding
catalog record objects inline within catalogs where the context is provided by the enclosing document.

@id.description: The unique identifier for the catalog record.

dcterms:title.description: A name given to the catalog record.

dcterms:description.description: A free-text account of the catalog record.

dcterms:issued.description: The date of listing of the catalog record in the catalog.

dcterms:modified.description: Most recent date on which the catalog record entry was changed or modified.

dcterms:conformsTo.description: An established standard to which the catalog record conforms.

foaf:primaryTopic.description: The dataset or data service described in the catalog record.
